files.mybharat-shell.css: mybharat-shell.css (jsDelivr CDN — same content as shell.css)

localTestingOnly.purpose: Local CakePHP / dev-machine testing when you have no S3 or org CDN access. Not for dev/beta/prod.

devBetaProd.purpose: Org CDN for dev, beta, and production. Host sets cdnBase (VITE_MYBHARAT_CDN_BASE / window.MYBHARAT_SHELL).
devBetaProd.note: Do not point dev/beta/prod at the personal GitHub jsDelivr URLs in package.json repository.

cdn.note: Do not use raw.githubusercontent.com in <link>/<script> — Content-Type text/plain causes net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB in Chrome.
